headline: Executive order sets up a government-wide effort on counterterrorism messaging aimed at audiences outside the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a coordinated strategy for how the federal government communicates about terrorism with people abroad. It also sets up a temporary organization to support certain of these government-wide communications activities directed overseas. No summary was provided, so details on structure, funding, and duration are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in foreign communications and counterterrorism
who_it_affects.how: They would coordinate their counterterrorism messaging abroad under a shared strategy and work with the new temporary organization.
They would be the target of the US government's coordinated counterterrorism communications.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 9, 2011; effective date not stated in the provided material.
